title: Tile collision data consumed by src/sim/world.ts
$comment: The file, its buildings and its ground are closed (meta stays open): an undeclared key fails the schema suite. Declare a new field here before shipping it; a key starting with x- is free for experiments and is never a contract.

underY.description: Optional underside, metres (absolute): a structure spanning a street or path (a deck, an arcade, a bridge between buildings; its record is the piece of the footprint over the carriageway) or a building standing over a tunnel bore (its foot). A body passes under it when the top of the body is at or below underY. Absent: solid down to the ground.

meta.description: Optional facts for facades and storefronts (year built, use, stories, source ids). Never read by the sim. The keys below are the pipeline's (docs/data-sources.md); other worlds may add their own.

footY.description: Lowest ground under the footprint minus 5 cm: where walls start so nothing floats

heightM.description: Height of this record's roof above the building's ground reference, metres

lidarM.description: LiDAR [median, max] height above ground, metres (2010 survey)

parcel.description: Assessor parcel (block + lot) joined to the footprint

stories.description: Storeys, when the assessor's count agrees with the measured height

units.description: Units on the parcel, or condominium units on the building

condo.description: The joined parcel is one unit of a condominium building

tower.description: On a podium record: the id of its tower record

towerOf.description: On a "-tower" record: the podium record's id

podiumTopY.description: On a "-tower" record: the podium's roof (absolute y)

pieceOf.description: On a piece record (id suffix -s<n> or -b<n>): the source footprint's record id, which keeps the rest of the footprint

piece.description: strip: a terrace of a hillside building with its own ground and roof (-s<n>); span: the part of a footprint over a street or path, with an underside (-b<n>)

decks.description: Road decks above the ground whose segments' midpoints lie in this tile (pipeline/lib/structures.ts): freeway viaducts and ramps, street bridges, streets over a freeway cut. path is [x, y, z, w] per vertex: centreline, road-surface height, full width; the surface between two vertices is the ruled quad between them. layer 1 stands over the ground, 2 over another deck.

id.description: Unique in the world: <ribbon id>~<piece number along it>

edge.description: The roads.json edge the deck carries

tunnels.description: Roads below the ground (bored tunnels portal to portal, underpasses beneath a freeway embankment) whose segments' midpoints lie in this tile: a ribbon as in decks (y = the road surface) plus a ceiling clearanceM above it. The ground above is not a surface for a body inside the bore.

movable.description: Deck pieces that lift (the Lefty O'Doul bascule on 3rd St). The leaf turns about the hinge line, rising on the side away from it, up to openRad. Its angle is sim state (SimState), never data.

deck.description: The id of the deck piece that lifts (in this tile)

water.description: Optional per-sample open-water flags, same layout as heights (1 = open water at sea level, 0 = land)
